# rendering-core

<!-- okfreq:index:start -->
<!-- Generated by okfreq lint; edit requirement metadata instead. -->

- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-001 — The preview renders the unsaved buffer completely, in process](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-001.md) — When the active Markdown buffer changes, the extension SHALL render the buffer text, saved or unsaved, completely to HTML inside the extension process and keep only the result of the newest edit.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-002 — Render the CommonMark blocks](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-002.md) — When a document holds CommonMark content, the extension SHALL render headings h1 to h6, paragraphs, bullet and numbered lists, block quotes, thematic breaks, emphasis, strong text, links, images and inline code as the matching HTML elements.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-003 — Every rendered block maps to its absolute source lines](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-003.md) — When a document is rendered, the extension SHALL give every paragraph, heading, block quote, list, list item, code block, table, math block, thematic break and definition list a one-based source line, with an end line for a multi-line block, counted in the whole file after a leading frontmatter block is left out of the body.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-004 — Map a multi-line block to its end line](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-004.md) — When a mapped block spans several source lines, the extension SHALL give it an end line in addition to its start line.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-005 — Hide leading frontmatter from the body](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-005.md) — When a document starts with a YAML frontmatter block, the extension SHALL leave that block out of the rendered body, so that it is not shown as a code block.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-006 — Keep body lines absolute after frontmatter](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-006.md) — When a leading frontmatter block is stripped, the extension SHALL number the body blocks by their absolute line in the file, counting LF, CRLF and CR line breaks.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-007 — Map image-only blocks](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-007.md) — When a paragraph holds only an image, an `{image}` directive or a lone raw `<img>` element, the extension SHALL render it as a mapped block with its source lines.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-008 — Images fit the column, sit on the line and survive a missing file](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-008.md) — When a document shows an image, the extension SHALL size it to at most the content column width and keep its aspect ratio, place it on the text line when it is written inside a line of text, and keep its element and alt text in document order when its local file is missing.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-009 — Keep an image whose file is missing](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-009.md) — When an image points to a local file that does not exist, the extension SHALL keep the image element and its alt text in document order and remove its source.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-010 — Wikilinks render as links where they are text](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-010.md) — When a document holds `\[\[Note\]\]`, `\[\[Folder/Note#Heading|Label\]\]` or `\[\[#Section\]\]` in plain text, the extension SHALL render a link, with a `wiki:` URL for a note target and an in-page slug anchor for a heading-only target, and leave `\[\[...\]\]` unconverted where it appears in code, an existing link, an image, math, raw HTML or an `!\[\[...\]\]` embed.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-011 — Leave wikilink syntax untouched where it is not text](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-011.md) — When `\[\[...\]\]` appears in code, an existing link, an image, math or raw HTML, or as an `!\[\[...\]\]` embed, the extension SHALL NOT convert it to a wikilink.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-012 — An include is expanded in place and mapped to its directive](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-012.md) — When a trusted document holds an `{include}` directive for a Markdown file inside its folder or the workspace root, the extension SHALL render that file's content in place of the directive, map every included block to the lines of the directive and leave an unsupported include form as an unresolved placeholder.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-013 — Includes are bounded by depth, budget, size and allowed roots](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-013.md) — When a chain of includes reaches the 8th level, an include repeats a file already being included, a render has expanded 2000 includes or 10 Mi characters of included text, an included file is larger than 5 MiB or cannot be read, or an include points outside the allowed roots, uses an absolute path or a URL scheme, has an undecodable path, has a symlink that escapes its root or names a missing file, the extension SHALL leave that directive as an unresolved placeholder and, for a refused or missing file or an exhausted budget, list a warning naming the request without reading a refused file.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-014 — Keep unsupported include forms as placeholders](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-014.md) — When an `{include}` has an empty argument, the `:literal:` option or an option other than `:class:` and `:label:`, the extension SHALL leave it as an unresolved placeholder.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-015 — Map included blocks to the include directive](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-015.md) — When a block comes from an included file, the extension SHALL map it to the lines of the `{include}` directive in the host document and mark it as included, also for nested includes.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-016 — Limit the include budget per render](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-016.md) — When a render has expanded 2000 includes or 10 Mi characters of included text, the extension SHALL list one budget warning and leave the remaining includes as placeholders.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-017 — Read a repeated include once per render](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-017.md) — When one file is included several times in a render, the extension SHALL read and parse it once and keep each use's own include line.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-018 — Refuse includes outside the allowed roots](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-018.md) — When an include points outside the allowed roots, uses an absolute path or a URL scheme, has an undecodable path or a symlink that escapes its root, the extension SHALL list a warning naming the request and not read the file.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-019 — Warn about a missing included file](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-019.md) — When an include names a file that does not exist, the extension SHALL list a warning naming the request in the status region.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-020 — Render read-only in an untrusted workspace](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-020.md) — When the workspace is untrusted or the file is standalone, the extension SHALL still render the preview read-only with the resource root reduced to the document's folder.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-021 — Refuse the render when trust is required](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-021.md) — When a document is rendered in an untrusted workspace and the reduced mode is not allowed, the render pipeline SHALL refuse with the message "The MyST preview is disabled until the workspace is trusted."
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-022 — Build-dependent constructs show an inert placeholder with a warning](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-022.md) — When a document holds a construct that only a full project build can resolve (an unknown directive, `toc`, an unexpanded `{include}`, `{embed}`, `{glossary}`, a known directive that renders nothing, a `{cite}` role, a `{bibliography}` directive, a `#tbl:` notebook output reference or an unexecuted `{code-cell}` output), the extension SHALL render an inert, muted placeholder that shows the name, arguments and body as text and list a warning for a directive, a notebook output or a code cell output while the render stays successful.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-023 — List a warning for an unavailable directive](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-023.md) — When a directive is replaced by a placeholder, the extension SHALL list "Directive {name} is not available outside a full build." with its line in the status region while the render stays successful.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-024 — List diagnostics with file, line and severity](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-024.md) — When a render yields diagnostics, the extension SHALL list each in the status region as a file, a line and a message with a severity.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-025 — A failed render keeps the previous page and lists its diagnostics](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-025.md) — When a render fails with an exception or yields diagnostics, the extension SHALL list each diagnostic in the status region as a file, a line and a message with a severity, and on a failure keep the failure message and mark the previous page as stale, or show an error page when no previous page exists.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-026 — Cancel a superseded render](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-026.md) — When a newer edit arrives during a render, the extension SHALL cancel that render and discard its late result with the message "The MyST render was canceled because a newer edit arrived."
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-027 — Warm the render engine at activation](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-027.md) — When the extension activates, the extension SHALL load the MyST engine once so that the first render does not pay the module load cost, swallowing a failure of that load without showing an error.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-028 — Body text, headings, lists and inline code are typeset readably](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-028.md) — When the preview shows paragraphs, list items, table cells, quotes, captions, headings, lists or inline code, the extension SHALL use the preview font, the zoomed font size and the VS Code Markdown preview line height for the body text, and typeset headings, list spacing, inline code and the end of the document by the rules of the scenarios.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-029 — Style headings](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-029.md) — When the preview shows headings, the extension SHALL use weight 600, h1 at 2em and h2 at 1.5em with a bottom rule, h3 at 1.25em and h4 at 1em, and let top- level headings clear floating figures.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-030 — Tighten list spacing](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-030.md) — When a list item holds paragraphs, the extension SHALL reduce the paragraph margins inside it and indent lists by 2em.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-031 — Style inline code as a pill](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-031.md) — When the preview shows inline code, the extension SHALL draw a tint and hairline derived from the text colour with a 4 px radius at 0.875em, padded on every wrapped line without growing the line height, scaled inside headings.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-032 — Keep inline code readable inside links](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-032.md) — When inline code sits inside a link, the extension SHALL use the link colour, and in forced white and cream themes on a translucent tint with a contrast of at least 4.5:1.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-033 — Keep inline code compact in tables](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-033.md) — When inline code sits in a table cell, the extension SHALL keep it compact, without splitting a short identifier in a sideways-scrolling table.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-034 — Long words, URLs, identifiers and CJK text wrap in the column](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-034.md) — When a word, a URL, an inline code identifier or a Japanese, Chinese or Korean paragraph is longer than the available width, the extension SHALL wrap it inside the column or pane at 900 px and 460 px, without horizontal overflow of the page.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-035 — Scroll wide tables inside their box](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-035.md) — When a table is wider than the content column, the extension SHALL scroll it inside its own box without widening the page.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-036 — Style placeholders as inert](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-036.md) — When the preview shows a placeholder for an unresolved directive, a citation, a notebook output or a bibliography, the extension SHALL style it as inert: muted text, a dashed box for a directive, a dotted underline and help cursor for a citation.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-037 — Reach the end of the document](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-037.md) — When a document is shown, the extension SHALL keep a bottom padding so that its last block ends at least 30 px above the frame bottom.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-038 — Render a very long document completely](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-038.md) — When a document of about 6000 lines is rendered, the extension SHALL render every section and heading and keep the last paragraph reachable.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-039 — Wrap CJK text in the pane](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-039.md) — When a paragraph holds Japanese, Chinese or Korean text, the extension SHALL wrap it inside the pane at 900 px and 460 px.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-040 — Wrap an unbroken word in the column](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-040.md) — When a word has no break opportunity and is longer than the column, the extension SHALL wrap it inside the column at 900 px and 460 px.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-041 — Right-to-left text aligns to the right and blocks get an automatic direction](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-041.md) — When a paragraph, heading, list item, block quote or table cell holds text, the extension SHALL give it `dir="auto"` when it has no dir attribute and keep an author's dir attribute only as ltr, rtl or auto, so that Hebrew or Arabic text aligns to the right edge of the column.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-042 — Wrap long URLs in the column](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-042.md) — When a paragraph holds a URL longer than the column, the extension SHALL wrap it inside the column without horizontal page overflow.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-043 — Find works in the preview](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-043.md) — When the preview panel is created, the extension SHALL enable the find widget so that Cmd/Ctrl+F searches the rendered page.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-044 — Drop unsupported raw HTML](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-044.md) — When a document holds a raw HTML block outside the supported subset (tables, details, kbd, colour spans, a lone img, context tags), the extension SHALL drop it from the rendered page.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-045 — Expand alerts in included files and context tags](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-045.md) — When a GitHub alert sits in an included file or a grouped context tag, the extension SHALL expand it as in the host document.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-046 — Render identically in every palette mode](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-046.md) — When the palette mode is Strict, GFM or MyST, the extension SHALL render the same HTML for the same Markdown, as the mode changes buttons only.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-047 — Show a citation as an unresolved placeholder](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-047.md) — When a document holds a `{cite}` role, the extension SHALL render an unresolved citation placeholder without appending a bibliography.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-048 — Glow blocks changed outside the preview](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-048.md) — When blocks are updated by a change made outside the preview, the extension SHALL make them glow once for about 600 ms, a code block on its `<pre>`.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-049 — Skip the glow when it would mislead](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-049.md) — When a changed block is included, has an open editor, the range list is empty or invalid, or the update exceeds 40 blocks or 50 ranges, the extension SHALL glow nothing.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-050 — Soft appearance and colour transitions honour reduced motion](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-050.md) — When the preview shows an editor, a bar, a menu, a closed editor or a theme change, the extension SHALL animate it softly by the rules of the scenarios and apply no preview motion when the user prefers reduced motion.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-051 — Enable soft appearance after the first input](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-051.md) — When the user presses a pointer button or a key for the first time, the extension SHALL turn on the soft appearance of editors, bars and menus.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-052 — Fade a closed editor back to its block](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-052.md) — When a block editor closes, the extension SHALL fade the rendered block back in.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-053 — Transition colours once on theme change](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-053.md) — When the theme changes, the extension SHALL transition the colours once.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-054 — List documents matching a toctree glob](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-054.md) — When a `{toctree}` entry uses `*`, `**`, `?` or `\[abc\]`, the extension SHALL list the matching `.md`, `.markdown` and `.myst` documents below the folder in sorted order.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-055 — Bound the toctree glob scan](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-055.md) — When a toctree glob scan runs, the extension SHALL read at most 200 matches, 400 folders and 8 levels, skipping `node_modules`, `.git`, `_build` and `out`.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-056 — Rebuild raw HTML tables from an allow-list](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-056.md) — When a document holds a raw HTML table, the extension SHALL rebuild it from an allow-list of tags and attributes, keep complex cell spans and safe cell styles and drop `embed`, `form`, `iframe`, `object`, `script`, `style` and `svg` inside it.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-057 — Render list-table headers, widths and alignment](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-057.md) — When a `{list-table}` has `:header-rows:`, `:widths:` or an alignment, the extension SHALL render `thead`/`th`, column widths and the alignment, ignoring widths whose count differs from the columns or that are not numbers.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-058 — Edit a list-table as one block](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-058.md) — When a `{list-table}` is rendered, the extension SHALL give its cell paragraphs no source line so that a click edits the whole table as one block.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-059 — Use a figure body as its caption](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-059.md) — When a figure's body supplies the text, the extension SHALL show it as the caption.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-060 — Keep references to captionless targets readable](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-060.md) — When a `{numref}` or `{ref}` points to a figure or table without a caption, the extension SHALL render a readable link, not an empty one.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-061 — Render version admonitions](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-061.md) — When a document holds `{versionadded}`, `{versionchanged}` or `{deprecated}`, the extension SHALL render an admonition titled "Added in version X:", "Changed in version X:" or "Deprecated since version X:" with its Markdown body parsed.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-062 — Render details and kbd blocks](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-062.md) — When a document holds a raw details block (with an optional open state and a summary) or kbd block, the extension SHALL render a dropdown or key element with its content parsed as Markdown.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-063 — Keep figure width and alignment](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-063.md) — When a MyST figure or image has a plain-length width or a left, center or right alignment, the extension SHALL keep them (the width as `data-okf-width`) and drop any other value.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-064 — Warn about MyST syntax of a disabled extension](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-064.md) — When a document uses syntax of an extension that the nearest `conf.py` does not enable, the extension SHALL list one `myst-extension` warning per extension, at most 10 per render, and leave the rendering unchanged.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-065 — Place inline images on the text line](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-065.md) — When an image is written inside a line of text, the extension SHALL render it inline and centred on the line, while an image alone in its paragraph stays a centred figure paragraph.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-066 — Ignore invalid page messages](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-066.md) — When the preview page sends a message, the extension SHALL validate it against the page-to-host protocol, ignoring an invalid one without user-visible change.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-067 — Refuse oversize included files](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-067.md) — When an included file is larger than 5 MiB, the extension SHALL leave its include directive as an unresolved placeholder.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-068 — Disable soft appearance after a content patch](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-068.md) — When a content patch replaces the content, the extension SHALL turn the soft appearance of editors, bars and menus off until the next pointer or key press.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-069 — The site Requirements page shows the requirements chain and the report figures](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-069.md) — When a maintainer builds the Pages site, the build SHALL write a Requirements page that draws the chain from use case to test and shows the figures of active requirements from the okfreq report, or states that the report was not generated when it is missing or unreadable, without failing the build.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-070 — A parse splits the source into lines once, whatever the number of directives](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-070.md) — When a document is parsed, the MyST parser SHALL split the source text into lines once per parse and reuse the lines for every directive fence, so that the parse time does not grow with the number of directives times the size of the document, and the tightness of each directive (blank lines before and after it) SHALL stay unchanged.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-071 — README-style HTML renders like GitHub and shows its tag in edit mode](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-CORE-071.md) — When a document holds README-style HTML (div and p with align, br, img with width, height and alt, a around img, picture with colour-scheme sources, sub, sup, kbd), the preview SHALL render those elements like GitHub, keep Markdown after a blank line inside an HTML block rendered, and, in edit mode, show each HTML block as an admonition-like block titled with its literal opening tag, without any script, event handler or style the sanitizer does not already keep.
